remarks: Looking for maintenance free living? The Kingswood is an adult 55+ majority community which currently has availablity for owners 21+ years old. This move-in ready, open concept 2 bedroom, 2 bath corner unit on 3rd floor boasts new laminate floors, new stainless steel appliances and has just been freshly painted. Easy access to parking space #1. Need additional storage? There is a separate private storage unit in the lower level. Association monthly fee includes heat/AC, water and electric. Very well managed and well maintained condominium building with on-site supervisor. Secure entry and convenient to public transportation, I-95, downtown Stamford and Darien shopping, restaurants and so much more. Many amenities including well equipped gym, great room with fireplace and pool table, patio courtyard with grilling area, movie theatre/business center, and new solar energy roofing system. Planned monthly events to socialize. All you need to do is unpack and start enjoying your beautiful new condo. Welcome home!
